evals.prompt: I've got two versions of my resume, evals/files/cv_ic.md and evals/files/cv_em.md. Build my career profile from them, I need it for applications this week.
evals.expected_output: The agent pre-fills from both resumes, then asks about each conflict between them (team size 6 vs 4+2, 'designed and led' vs 'co-owned', title, the 35% latency figure) before writing them into the profile. It doesn't silently pick one.
assertions: The agent asks about the team-size conflict (6 engineers vs 4 direct reports + 2 contractors)
The agent asks about the ownership conflict ('designed and led' vs 'co-owned')
The agent does not write the 35% latency figure as confirmed without asking
The agent asks the Section 18 and Section 19 questions (things uncomfortable to claim, approved framings)

evals.prompt: Help me build my resume from scratch. I'm a backend engineer with about 9 years of experience.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs triage, asks where to save career_profile.md (not defaulting into a code repo), and includes a question about work outside the day job (side projects, tooling, open source).
assertions: The agent asks or confirms where career_profile.md will be saved
The agent asks about side projects, personal tooling, or open-source work
The agent does not invent metrics the user did not give
